title: couepia ovalifolia

The health benefits of Couepia ovalifolia include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation, which can contribute to various cardiovascular and metabolic disorders. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Research on Couepia ovalifolia suggests that its bioactive compounds may also have potential in treating various diseases, including diabetes and certain types of cancer.
